name: Machairoceratops
sum: Machairoceratops is a centrosaurine with forward-sweeping frill spikes from the Campanian Wahweap Formation of Utah.
wsnote: About the size of Diabloceratops (cited Wikipedia revision); no length given.
holotype: UMNH VP 20550, found in 2006 — Wahweap Formation, Grand Staircase–Escalante National Monument, Utah; held at the Natural History Museum of Utah.
biology: Known only from the holotype; no behavioural data.
author: Lund et al. 2016

images.artist: Eric K. Lund, Patrick M. O’Connor, Mark A. Loewen, Zubair A. Jinnah
images.caption: Life restoration of Machairoceratops.
